details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. It ships a package.json postinstall hook ("node beacon.cjs") and a module-level call in index.js that, at install and import time, sends a JSON POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with the header X-Beacon-Package: @c1-ease/autoloan. The beaconed body contains only installation metadata: the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory (__dirname), the current working directory, the npm/node user-agent string, and the transport protocol. It also disables TLS certificate verification (rejectUnauthorized: false) for the callback. No environment variables, credentials, tokens, wallet data, or file contents are read or transmitted, and no secondary payload is downloaded or executed. index.js exports a catch-all Proxy that returns no-op functions so that importing the package does not break the surrounding build.
